profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
I am a committed individual who is passionate about all aspects of Computer Science. I enjoy applying my learning wherever possible, and have the ability to quickly gain new skills.

My speciality is programming for iOS in both Swift and Objective-C, and I have approximately 5 years of experience publishing applications to the iOS App Store in the latter. In 2015 I won an award from Apple and attended their annual World-Wide Developers Conference (WWDC).

projects.title: StemCode
projects.description:
StemCode is my undergraduate dissertation project that I am developing as part of BlackPoint LTD. The project has been making excellent progress, and is due for completion in March 2016. The purpose of developing StemCode is to create the worlds first true desktop-class IDE for the iPad, as software development is the only area where the iPad has very little to offer.

Due to time limitations, the only languages officially supported are C and C++, however this will be expanded once the first release is available to developers world wide. C and C++ code may be run on the iPad via a custom-built interpreter, or alternatively executed on a Linux server. 

Other features that the app currently has/will have include semantic syntax highlighting, code completion, debugging, memory inspection and more.

This project has massively advanced my ability to develop for iOS, and in the past 4 months alone I would say I have learned almost as much as in the 4 years beforehand. One of the most advanced libraries that this project has required me to learn and use is libclang, and this shows that I am able to be "thrown in at the deep end" and thoroughly learn what I need in order to get the job done well.
